summary: Add an OMP-only transcript seed fenced by one durable first native launch outcome per seat.

replay.detail: Existing native binding claims win without rewriting history. First launch outcomes use the existing compare-and-create claim mechanism.

schema.detail: No database migration. Adds typed custom.agent.first-native-launch receipts with fresh or seeded outcomes.

rules.detail: Existing claim admission and actor authority remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Only OMP harness declarations accept seed. Seed conflicts with authored selectors and resume environment. Every native first launch records a seat-scoped outcome, independent of path, revision, account and harness.

manual.detail: Declare an absolute owner-local OMP transcript as seed rather than permanent resume arguments. Invalid input fails without consuming the opportunity.

recovery.detail: A receipt without any native binding is explicitly incomplete and never silently reseeds. Inspect the interrupted first launch and staged transcript; existing bindings retain ordinary continuation.

downtime.detail: Normal daemon upgrade restart; interruption duration has not been measured.
